metadata.name: quantum_hooks
metadata.description: Quant Pad Quantum Hooks: creator-fee routing for pump.fun coins

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The coin mint's owner: Token-2022 for `create_v2` coins, SPL Token for coins made with
pump.fun's legacy `create` (bound by the `mint::token_program` constraint).

accounts.name: lp_token_program
docs: PumpSwap always mints LP tokens with Token-2022.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody can front-run the deploy.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Gets back the rent of the well's WSOL ATA when this pulse closes it. The PumpSwap collect
leg creates that ATA at the transaction payer's expense; only creator fees are split.

accounts.name: well_wsol_ata
docs: `spend` into it and closes it back into the well afterwards. The curve route omits it
(and `wsol_mint` / `quote_token_program`) to keep the transaction small.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The coin mint's owner: Token-2022 for `create_v2` coins, SPL Token for coins made with
pump.fun's legacy `create` (bound by the `mint::token_program` constraint).

accounts.name: mint
docs: The fresh mint keypair pump.fun `create_v2` initialises right after this instruction.
Its signature binds the hooks to whoever creates the coin.

errors.name: InvalidAllocation
errors.msg: Allocation bps (creator + burn + entangle + fusion) must sum to 10000

errors.name: TooManySplits
errors.msg: At most 4 Superposition splits are allowed

errors.name: InvalidSplitBps
errors.msg: Each split needs 1..=10000 bps and all splits together at most 10000

errors.name: InvalidSplitWallet
errors.msg: Split wallets must be distinct ordinary wallets: not the default key, the well, the Quantum account, a sysvar or a program

errors.name: InvalidLockTerms
errors.msg: Invalid lock terms: need 0 <= cliff <= duration and 0 < duration <= 4 years

errors.name: LockTermsMismatch

errors.name: MintNotFresh

errors.name: Paused

errors.name: ProtocolBpsTooHigh

errors.name: InvalidConfig

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority

errors.name: NotAuthority

errors.name: NotLauncher

errors.name: AlreadyLocked

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: NothingToRelease

errors.name: SplitAccountsMismatch

errors.name: MissingTokenProgram

errors.name: SpendTooHigh

errors.name: ProofTooLong

fields.name: venue
docs: 0 = bonding curve (pump.fun), 1 = PumpSwap pool.

fields.name: bitmap
docs: One bit per leaf, `ceil(leaf_count / 8)` bytes.

fields.name: unwrapped
docs: WSOL (creator fees) unwrapped from the well's WSOL account before allocation, without the
account's rent (see `rent_refunded`).

fields.name: collected
docs: Unallocated lamports this pulse distributed (`available`).

fields.name: deferred
docs: Payments skipped because the recipient could not hold them (would stay below its rent
minimum, or is executable). They stay in the well and are re-pulsed later.

fields.name: rent_refunded
docs: Rent of the closed WSOL account, returned to the pulse's `rent_payer` (not fees).

fields.name: planned_cliff_secs
docs: Lock terms committed at registration (0/0 = none planned). `lock` must use them.

fields.name: lock
docs: Time Dilation terms the later `lock` must use; `None` when no lock is planned.

fields.name: bps
docs: Share of the creator slice in bps.
